title: Budget
description: Budget allocation for a user's spending category. Tracks budgeted amount, actual spending, period, and currency for personal finance and expense management.

id.description: Unique identifier for the budget record

user_id.description: Foreign key reference to the user who owns this budget

category.description: Budget category (e.g., groceries, entertainment, transportation, utilities)

amount.description: Budgeted amount allocated for this category

spent.description: Total amount already spent in this category for the current period

period.description: Budget period (e.g., monthly, weekly, yearly, custom)

currency.description: ISO currency code for budget amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)
